text_block_list.text:
Before the concert began, Mihono Bourbon 
arrived at the venue. Standing quietly, 
she seemed lost in thought.

Meanwhile, in the wings waiting for the 
main event, Smart Falcon was encouraging 
Silence Suzuka, who had a stiff look on 
her face.

Believing that the message carried by song 
will reach someone's heart... The second 
concert begins!
